body:
Please note that this is not my personal experience, but rather the experience of my roommate
this is not my personal experience, but rather the experience of my roommate
that I was observing and documenting. From here on I will refer to roommate as D.
D has experimented with nbome twice, this being his second experience and his first being exactly one week ago. Slight tolerance noted. Unfortunately, I was not there to observe his experience with the nbome, but had been able to see the comedown mixed with the cannabis and eventually DMT.
D had initially placed 6 tabs of 500mcg Nbome between his upper lip and gum totaling 3000mcg. Five hours later he had decided to redose with the same amount. He notes that the experience is significantly more intense and longer on the re-dose and extremely enjoyable.
Another five hours later, Visuals had become very weak and D proceeded to smoke a bowl of cannabis.
The Experience:
After smoking the cannabis, D begins to note that the visuals are far more intense than any of the visuals he had seen that day. They had also taken on a style unlike that of the nbome earlier.
Temples begin to spring up everywhere along the walls and ceiling to form a matrix-like robotic and futuristic civilization. The civilization begins to be populated by cartoony alien Alice-In-Wonderland-esque entities. They do not appear to be part of the wall, but rather holograms that are being projected from it.
The visuals begin to move very rapidly, some parts of the room become intimidating as eyes begin to pop up and populate both the structures as well as the entities. On some parts of the ceiling, young alien beings are being operated on and begin to transform from young aliens to adult aliens. He notes that the before and after are very different, much like a caterpillar to a butterfly.
D notes that the visuals are neither feel good nor bad, although he says that the potential for everything to become frightening is there. He also notes that the structures and ruins within the civilization have rectangular appearances while the beings tend to be more circular.
When staring at the visuals on the wall and ceiling the images begin to change very rapidly. Later on he notes that although they cycle through many different images they seem to follow some sort of pattern. D also notes that thinking or any type of thoughts will disrupt the flow.
D feels that his state of mind is rather chaotic and that the visuals on the room are reflecting that at the moment. He also feels that ego death is relatively close and would be rather easy to fall into.
Eventually the cartoony effect of some of the visuals become weaker and the images become dominated by robotic and alien visuals accompanied by the millions of eyes everywhere. D appears to have all of his attention placed on the visuals noting that he feels as if they symbolize something very important.
Color overtones become predominantly green and yellow. D later says that there is no 'Safe Spot'. Lights have been turned off and D states that the visuals have disappeared completely. He notes that the ceiling has disappeared and that the room had become an endless abyss. My eyes adjust, but his do not.
The eyes return very strongly, but appear to have a different style from the eyes appearing while the light is on. However, the other visuals appear to be absent.
The lights have been turned on and D states that he has a headache. The headache appears to be common between the two of us and typically happens on higher doses of nbome. He constantly notes that the visuals are extremely strange.
Two of our friends walk in at this point, and they begin to talk to D. D has become very tired at this point and decides to smoke a bowl of DMT in hopes of 'flushing out' the visuals. He begins to smoke 50mg of DMT through a pipe.
Faint cartoon characters on the walls 'pop out of' and appear to come alive. He notes that the bed he is sitting on appears to have magically dropped to the floor and cycle between red, yellow, and other colors. Also, the room's colors begin to change at an extremely fast pace.
The style of the visuals completely change and English is no longer comprehensible to D and became gibberish. Visuals begin to go away. Light feathery feeling noted and he decides to go out and smoke one more bowl.
Comes back and notes visuals are back but extremely faint. D then proceeds to go to sleep.
